value.rationale: Constrained polynomial lemniscate area is a motivated specialization of the contemporary Erdős problem. Balanced root multiplicities are the simplest plausible two-site extremal pattern. Determining the exact first degree where it fails, with complete minimizer classification through that degree and an infinite family of consequent failures, resolves a structural transition not a gratuitous parameter slice. The exact rational certificate answers an otherwise unresolved finite comparison and supplies a reusable area-verification method; no separate downstream theorem is required.
